package domain

import (
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type CourseAssignmentStatus string

const (
	CourseAssignmentAssigned   CourseAssignmentStatus = "ASSIGNED"
	CourseAssignmentInProgress CourseAssignmentStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
	CourseAssignmentPaused     CourseAssignmentStatus = "PAUSED"
	CourseAssignmentCompleted  CourseAssignmentStatus = "COMPLETED"
	CourseAssignmentArchived   CourseAssignmentStatus = "ARCHIVED"
)

const CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner = "learning_planner"

// StudentCourseAssignment is Student-owned access to one ordinary Course.
// A student can own several assignments at the same time.
type StudentCourseAssignment struct {
	ID                       string                 `json:"id"`
	StudentID                string                 `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID                 string                 `json:"course_id"`
	Status                   CourseAssignmentStatus `json:"assignment_status"`
	AssignedBy               string                 `json:"assigned_by"`
	InitialPlanningRequestID string                 `json:"initial_planning_request_id"`
	AssignedAt               time.Time              `json:"assigned_at"`
	StartedAt                *time.Time             `json:"started_at,omitempty"`
	CompletedAt              *time.Time             `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
	ArchivedAt               *time.Time             `json:"archived_at,omitempty"`
}

type CourseAssignmentRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey    string
	PlanningRequestID string
	RequestHash       string
	AssignmentID      string
}

func NormalizeStudentCourseAssignment(input StudentCourseAssignment) (StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.AssignedBy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.AssignedBy))
	input.InitialPlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.InitialPlanningRequestID)
	if !validAssignmentUUID(input.ID) || !validAssignmentUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validAssignmentUUID(input.CourseID) || !validAssignmentUUID(input.InitialPlanningRequestID) ||
		input.AssignedBy != CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner || input.AssignedAt.IsZero() ||
		!validCourseAssignmentStatus(input.Status) {
		return StudentCourseAssignment{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.AssignedAt = input.AssignedAt.UTC()
	input.StartedAt = utcAssignmentTime(input.StartedAt)
	input.CompletedAt = utcAssignmentTime(input.CompletedAt)
	input.ArchivedAt = utcAssignmentTime(input.ArchivedAt)
	if input.StartedAt != nil && input.StartedAt.Before(input.AssignedAt) ||
		input.CompletedAt != nil && input.CompletedAt.Before(input.AssignedAt) ||
		input.ArchivedAt != nil && input.ArchivedAt.Before(input.AssignedAt) ||
		input.Status == CourseAssignmentArchived && input.ArchivedAt == nil ||
		input.Status != CourseAssignmentArchived && input.ArchivedAt != nil {
		return StudentCourseAssignment{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validCourseAssignmentStatus(status CourseAssignmentStatus) bool {
	switch status {
	case CourseAssignmentAssigned, CourseAssignmentInProgress, CourseAssignmentPaused,
		CourseAssignmentCompleted, CourseAssignmentArchived:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validAssignmentUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil
}

func utcAssignmentTime(value *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if value == nil {
		return nil
	}
	normalized := value.UTC()
	return &normalized
}
